text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — I'm putting together a concise launch acceptance runbook for the Optimize toolkit (batching + caching + quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts). Goal: make the gating criteria objective so we can onboard 2 pilot customers and then ramp.
Rina Patel: love this. can you paste the candidate gates? quick bullets ok.
Alex Chen: sure — initial proposal:
- Pilot readiness: 2 customers integrated with SDK + example config.
- Reliability SLO: end-to-end recommendation latency p95 < 300ms (hosted) for 95% of requests during pilot traffic.
- Cost signal: median token-cost delta vs baseline <= 20% for recommended configs.
- Quality guard: eval-triggered alerts must detect regression with TPR >= 0.8 on our canonical prompt suite.
- Observability: telemetry for batching sizes, cache hit rates, quantized model fallbacks in logs + tracing.
- Runbook: automated rollback to conservative config if eval alert fires or p99 latency > 750ms for 5m.
Mark O'Connor: are those latency targets realistic for Dedicated customers on larger seq lengths? we should scope by class: mobile/short-seq vs long-context.
Sophia Lee: good point. propose splitting SLOs by context bucket. short (<=512): p95 < 200ms, medium (512-2048): p95 < 350ms, long (>2048): p95 < 700ms. keep the hosted baseline at your 300ms number.
Rina Patel: agree on buckets. for the cost signal — can we make it a per-customer rolling window (24h) so noisy days don't gate launches?
Alex Chen: yes — change to 24h rolling median. also add acceptance threshold: no more than 10% of customer requests show quality regression flagged by eval hooks over 24h.
Sophia Lee: for eval-triggered alerts, here's a quick snippet we'll use in the alert config:
```
alert_rule:
  type: eval_regression
  threshold: 0.15   # absolute drop in score
  tpr_target: 0.8
  window: 24h
```
Rina Patel: where does 'score' come from? need to be explicit in runbook: accuracy metric name, dataset used, and severity tiers.
Alex Chen: yes — canonical prompt suite = OPTIMIZE_CANONICAL_V1; default metric = normalized_concordance_score; severity tiers: warn (0.05 drop), critical (0.15 drop).
Mark O'Connor: infra notes: we need retention for per-token traces for at least 72h to debug regressions; also rate-limited export to customer storage for compliance.
Sophia Lee: implementation constraint: KV cache metrics currently emit only per-shard counters. we'll add a composed metric (global cache_hit_rate) but that takes ~2 sprints. put it in 'nice-to-have' not blocking.
Alex Chen: okay — blocking items list for launch: SDK + example config, eval hooks wired to monitoring, automated rollback runbook, 2 pilot customers signed up for the test window, basic telemetry (batch size, cache hits as available), and documented acceptance checklist.
Rina Patel: customer asks: AcmeHealth wants an explicit guarantee for fallback behavior (no data leaves VPC), and FinLedger wants a control to force conservative configs for regulatory periods.
Alex Chen: add those as customer-driven gating items: VPC-safe fallback and a customer-configurable ‘conservative_mode’ switch. both must be demoable in pilot.
Mark O'Connor: ops automation: can we wire canary toggles so we can flip conservative_mode via feature flag and monitor rollback automatically? otherwise oncall will be busy.
Sophia Lee: yes — feature flag exists in infra; engineer estimate to wire it into the SDK + console: 3-5 days.
Alex Chen: action items:
- Alex: draft runbook doc + acceptance checklist by EOD Wed (1774590000 ETA).
- Sophia: prototype eval alert config in staging and share sample logs by Tue.
- Mark: validate retention and export constraints with infra & legal, report blockers by Wed.
- Rina: get verbal sign-off from AcmeHealth & FinLedger PMs for pilot constraints by next Fri.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: optimize-toolkit/staging -> canary at 1774512450, triggered by @Alex Chen.
Rina Patel: noted. one more ask — let's add explicit rollback SLA: auto-rollback within 10m of critical eval alert + manual rollback verb in console.
Alex Chen: agreed. adding to runbook.
Sophia Lee: tiny nit — for quantization we should record a 'fallback_count' metric when we switch from q8->fp16. helps correlate quality drops.
Mark O'Connor: +1. ops will need an alert on fallback_count spikes as a separate signal.
Alex Chen: cool — I'll update checklist. If there are no objections I'll call this the Launch Gate proposal and move to doc PR.
Rina Patel: no objections from product side. :+1:
Sophia Lee: sounds good.
Mark O'Connor: fine from ops.
Alex Chen: great — PR incoming. I'll mention owners and ship date targets in the doc. thanks all!
